scripts.data:summary: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const merged=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('public/data/projects.generated.json','utf8'));const diagDir='logs/diagnostics';for(const file of fs.existsSync(diagDir)?fs.readdirSync(diagDir):[]){if(!file.endsWith('.json')||file==='summary.json') continue; const full=path.join(diagDir,file); const report=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(full,'utf8')); report.mergedRowCount=merged.filter((item)=>String(item.sourceName||'').includes(report.sourceName)).length; fs.writeFileSync(full, JSON.stringify(report,null,2)+'\n','utf8');} const summary=(fs.existsSync(diagDir)?fs.readdirSync(diagDir):[]).filter((file)=>file.endsWith('.json')&&file!=='summary.json').map((file)=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(diagDir,file),'utf8'))); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(diagDir,'summary.json'), JSON.stringify(summary,null,2)+'\n','utf8'); summary.forEach((report)=>console.log('[summary:'+report.sourceKey+'] strategy='+report.strategy+' raw='+report.rawRowCount+' normalized='+report.normalizedRowCount+' merged='+report.mergedRowCount+' failures='+(report.failureReasons||[]).join('|')));"
